gloss: to let flow out; to discharge; to spew

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {垂|た}れ{流|なが}しませんでした

forms.label: ている polite
forms.negative: {垂|た}れ{流|なが}していません

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {垂|た}れ{流|なが}していなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.affirmative: {垂|た}れ{流|なが}していました
forms.negative: {垂|た}れ{流|なが}していませんでした

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {垂|た}れ{流|なが}さなかったら

definitions.gloss: to let flow out; to discharge carelessly
definitions.explanation: To allow liquid or waste to flow out without proper treatment or control. Often used critically about pollution or improper waste disposal.

definitions.gloss: to spew out; to broadcast indiscriminately
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe spreading information, complaints, or content carelessly and without restraint, often on social media or in the media.

examples.japanese: {汚水|おすい}を{川|かわ}に{垂|た}れ{流|なが}す。
examples.english: To discharge wastewater into the river.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}が{有害|ゆうがい}な{廃液|はいえき}を{垂|た}れ{流|なが}していた。
examples.english: The factory was discharging harmful waste liquid.

examples.japanese: {未処理|みしょり}の{排水|はいすい}を{海|うみ}に{垂|た}れ{流|なが}すのは{法律|ほうりつ}で{禁|きん}じられている。
examples.english: Discharging untreated wastewater into the sea is prohibited by law.

examples.japanese: SNSで{愚痴|ぐち}を{垂|た}れ{流|なが}す。
examples.english: To spew complaints on social media.

examples.japanese: テレビが{同|おな}じニュースを{一日中|いちにちじゅう}{垂|た}れ{流|なが}している。
examples.english: The TV is broadcasting the same news all day long.

examples.japanese: {根拠|こんきょ}のない{情報|じょうほう}をネットで{垂|た}れ{流|なが}すのは{無責任|むせきにん}だ。
examples.english: It's irresponsible to spew unfounded information on the internet.

notes:
USAGE:
A godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}) conjugating as {垂|た}れ{流|なが}さない, {垂|た}れ{流|なが}します, {垂|た}れ{流|なが}して. Both senses carry a strongly negative connotation — the action is always seen as irresponsible or excessive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {汚水|おすい}を{垂|た}れ{流|なが}す (to discharge dirty water)
- {愚痴|ぐち}を{垂|た}れ{流|なが}す (to spew complaints)
- {情報|じょうほう}を{垂|た}れ{流|なが}す (to broadcast information indiscriminately)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {流|なが}す: to let flow — neutral, without the negative connotation
- {排出|はいしゅつ}する: to emit, to discharge — more formal and technical
